changes.title: Book a free consultation from a phone.
changes.text: The consultation form sits on a separate Contact page today. The sketch puts a Book a free consultation button right under the headline.

changes.title: Tap to call for Houston and DFW.
changes.text: Both office lines become buttons, so a homeowner in either metro reaches the right person in one tap.

changes.title: Your products up front.
changes.text: Plantation shutters, blinds and shades, and draperies each get a card instead of long paragraphs.
